player.name: Video player
player.description: Plays the videos in a folder of the frame's assets one after another: by name or shuffled, the folder or one video again and again. A tap shows the controls (10 seconds back and on, pause, the video before and after, the list, a bar to drag); a double tap on a side skips 10 seconds, a swipe changes the video; the arrow keys, space, N and P work too. Where it was is kept on disk.
